title: Fix retries without changing the client contract

messages.content: The client retries every failed request, including validation errors. Update send() so only 429 and 5xx responses are retried. Keep the public method signature unchanged. Add regression tests for a 400 response and a transient 503.
I will move the retry decision into send() and add a maxRetries argument so callers can configure the behavior.
Stop — don't add another argument. Our integrations already depend on this signature. Use the existing RetryPolicy inside the client; only change which responses are eligible for retry.

content.text: Understood. I will keep send(request) unchanged and use RetryPolicy.shouldRetry(status).

title: Explain a failing cancellation test
prompt: Why does the retry timer fire after the request is canceled? Show the relevant control flow before editing anything.
response: The retry branch creates a timer and waits only on timer.C. Cancellation is checked before the timer starts, not while it is waiting. A select on ctx.Done() and timer.C would allow cancellation during backoff. I have not made a change.

title: CLIENT-42: stop retrying validation failures
description:
Expected behavior:
- Return 400 immediately.
- Retry 429 and 5xx according to RetryPolicy.
- Stop waiting when the request is canceled.

Acceptance requires regression coverage for all three cases.

title: Retry policy · failure handling
before: The client retries failed requests up to three times. Callers can rely on eventual completion.
after: The client retries 429 and 5xx responses according to RetryPolicy. Validation failures return immediately. Cancellation stops the retry wait. Retries do not guarantee completion.
